name: smarthire-site
description: The marketing site. Everything a visitor sees before they have an account: the pitch, how it works, features, pricing and the comparison. No auth, no database, no payment keys.
_comment_port: 3001, forced. apps/web's dev script takes 3000 and apps/desktop's .env points WEB_URL at http://127.0.0.1:3000 — the IP rather than localhost, because Electron's main process runs Node and resolves localhost to ::1 without falling back. If this app could win the race for 3000, the desktop would silently talk to the marketing site and every licence check would 404.
_comment_no_turbo: No --turbo flag, unlike apps/web. Turbopack is the default bundler in Next 16; that flag is a v15 leftover over there and is not worth propagating.
_comment_deps: THREE DELIBERATE ABSENCES, compared with apps/web. (1) No @supabase/* — this deployment asks nobody whether they are signed in, so it holds no Supabase keys at all and the whole class of cookie-scoping problems is unreachable rather than merely avoided. (2) No autoprefixer — apps/web lists it but its postcss config never loads it, and Tailwind v4 runs Lightning CSS internally; a dead dependency is not worth carrying forward. (3) No stripe — this site never starts a checkout; it links to the app, which does.
